citation_detail: Caesar, The Gallic War. Loeb Classical Library 72. Trans. H.J. Edwards. Harvard University Press, 1917. Books 1-7.
notes: Caesar's own account of the Gallic Wars. Primary but self-serving; authorial bias must be noted. LCL 72.

citation_detail: Caesar, The Civil Wars. Loeb Classical Library 39. Trans. A.G. Peskett. Harvard University Press, 1914. Books 1-3.
notes: Caesar's account of the civil war. Primary but partisan. LCL 39.

citation_detail: Plutarch, Life of Caesar. In: Plutarch's Lives, Vol. VII. Loeb Classical Library 99. Trans. Bernadotte Perrin. Harvard University Press, 1919. Ch. 1-69. Key passages: Ch. 1-2 (birth), Ch. 32 (Rubicon), Ch. 42-46 (Pharsalus), Ch. 59 (calendar reform), Ch. 60-66 (assassination).
notes: Plutarch's Parallel Lives, Life of Caesar. Later biography drawing on lost sources. LCL 99.

citation_detail: Cassius Dio, Roman History, Books 37-44. Loeb Classical Library 53 (Books 36-40) and LCL 66 (Books 41-45). Trans. Earnest Cary. Harvard University Press, 1914-1927.
